summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Michèle Gurdal, a Belgian professional tennis player born 30 November 1952 who was most prominent in the 1970s. It notes her Federation Cup representation for Belgium and her single WTA Tour singles title.
one_line: Michèle Gurdal is a Belgian tennis player born in 1952, prominent in the 1970s, with one WTA singles title.
key_facts: Michèle Gurdal was born on 30 November 1952.
Michèle Gurdal is a Belgian professional tennis player.
Michèle Gurdal was most prominent in the 1970s.
Michèle Gurdal represented Belgium in the Federation Cup every year between 1972 and 1980.
Michèle Gurdal won one singles title on the WTA Tour.
Michèle Gurdal's one WTA singles title was the 1976 Swiss Open.
